data.name: Alurd
data.gender_notes: Alurd is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Germanic elements, Alurd means 'Exalted Counselor'. This name was borne by King Alaric I of the Visigoths, who ruled from 395 to 410 AD. The name Alurd carries the meaning “Exalted Counselor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alurd usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted counselor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing wise guidance and exalted spiritual status.
data.etymology: Alurd belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted Counselor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alurd total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: עלורד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם עלורד הוא שם מורכב, שהוא בעצם תעתוק של השם האנגלי. אף על פי שאין השם עלורד קשור לברית החדשה או לברית הישנה, השם עלורד מורכב, ואפשרי שהוא קשור לשם האל עלי. עלי הוא סוללה דתיות, ובפרט במזרח, שם הוא ידוע כסמל לאל.

in_greek.name: Ἀλοῦρδης
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ ὄνομα Ἀλοῦρδης ὑποδείκνυται ὡς ἕνα ἀπὸ τῶν ὀνομάτων τοῦ Θεοῦ. Ἀν και οὐχ ὑπάρχει ἀπευθείας ἀποδείξει, ἡ ὀνομασία Ἀλοῦρδης μάλλον ἡνωμένη ἐστὶν μετὰ τοῦ ονόματος αὐτοῦ, Ἄλλος.

in_latin.name: Alurdus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Alurdus videtur esse unum ex nominibus Dei. Etiamsi non habet directam probationem, nomen Alurdus potius coniunctum est cum nomine suo, Alter.

in_english.name: Alurd
in_english.meaning: Name of God, derived from Alter, meaning other or another
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alurd is derived from the Latin word 'alter,' which means 'other' or 'another.' As a name of God, Alurd may be associated with the concept of God as the other or the one who is beyond human comprehension. In biblical tradition, names often reflect the character or attributes of the person or deity being named. In this sense, the name Alurd may suggest a God who is beyond human categories or who exists beyond the boundaries of human understanding.

data.cultural_impact: Alurd can be seen as a symbol of leadership and guidance, reminding us of the power and influence of strong, wise rulers in history.
data.spiritual_significance: In a deeper sense, Alurd signifies the divine presence and guidance in our lives. Just as a wise monarch offers counsel and protection, God provides us with valuable guidance and unending love. His counsel is exalted above all, a source of comfort and strength in times of uncertainty.
